title: Actual scrap per material
description: Actual scrap quantity and production cost (HK2) per plant and material over a reporting window, with the planned assembly scrap for comparison.

_id.description: Deterministic key from the natural key; see title.

plantId.description: Platform plant (plants@1) resolved from the source plant code or name; null when unresolved (reported).

plantCode.description: Plant code or name exactly as the source states it.

materialNumber.description: Source material number without leading zeros; null for rows without a material.

articleId.description: articles@1 _id (<sapSystem>-<materialNumber>) when the plant's SAP system is known and the article exists; otherwise null.

description.description: Source material text; kept for plants without SAP articles.

scrapCost.description: HK2 cost of scrap in currency.

plannedScrapRate.description: Planned assembly scrap from the material master, as a fraction.

excessScrapCost.description: Scrap cost above the planned assembly scrap.

currency.description: Currency of the cost fields (plant local currency).

scrapCostEur.description: scrapCost converted with eurRate; null when no rate exists.

eurRate.description: EUR per currency unit used: latest actual monthly group rate (version AC, type M) up to windowTo; 1 for EUR.

active.description: False when no longer present in the complete global source snapshot.
